 Summary
 Arsenal face Everton and Coventry host Fulham in Premier League
 Konsa gives Gunners early lead - they will go level on points with leaders Man City with win
 Watch Final Score at top of page, with choice of commentary via 'watch & listen' tab
 Aston Villa end City's 100% start thanks to Jackson double - report & ratings 
 Chelsea v Tottenham follows at 17:30
 Close form Send us your views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Gary Rose & Sam Drury
 Show Most recent Most popular Post published at 15:29 BST 15:29 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Antonee Robinson miscues an attempted clearance and Brandon Thomas-Asante looks to be in, but he sends his shot wide. Robinson did well to recover and do enough to put Thomas-Asante off.
 1 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:28 BST 15:28 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Lovely little pass around the corner from Declan Rice to find Noni Madueke.
 The Arsenal winger drives into the box but drags his right-foot shot wide.
 A decent chance that.
 150 38 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:28 BST 15:28 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Matt Grimes overhits a pretty routine pass to Jay Dasilva and the ball goes out of play.
 It hasn't been a classic here.
 16 24 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Home form is everything for Coventry' published at 15:25 BST 15:25 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on Final Score 
 I think it's going to be difficult for them. The gulf between the Championship and the Premier League is still very different. 
 You're off the back of two wins, and then you lose against Tottenham, if you can bounce back with a win straight after it, you stand a chance of surviving. 
 The home form is everything. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 92 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:24 BST 15:24 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Sweeping move from Arsenal but Eberechi Eze scuffs the shot wide of the far post at the end of it.
 142 99 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:22 BST 15:22 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Important clearance on the stretch from Merlin Rohl to divert a deep cross away from Viktor Gyokeres.
 Arsenal have another corner. And another. But Everton deal with them well enough.
 173 81 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:22 BST 15:22 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 It's almost as if Arsenal expected Everton to roll over once they got the goal but it hasn't happened. 
 171 191 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:21 BST 15:21 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Better from Coventry as Brandon Thomas-Asante gets away from his marker to meet a cross but sends his header over.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 60 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:21 BST 15:21 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Arsenal come forward for the first time since going in front and Mikel Merino's clever pass finds Ben White in space at the back post.
 He doesn't want to take on the shot, lays the ball off to Martin Odegaard and he opts against shooting as well.
 That gives Everton time to get men back and crowd the Gunners out.
 92 92 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Everton are back in this game' published at 15:19 BST 15:19 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on Final Score 
 Their response has brilliant, at the start of the game they allowed Arsenal to come onto them. 
 But Everton are back in this game in terms of confidence. 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 204 202 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 George 'looking the most dangerous' published at 15:19 BST 15:19 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Tyrique George is afraid of absolutely no-one, he'll take you on, ask the question and if he gets it wrong, he'll do the same again next time. 
 It's great to see that belief and confidence and also the backing of his manager to do that. He's looking the most dangerous. 
 156 97 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:18 BST 15:18 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 This time it's Arsenal scrambling to defend a corner.
 Not entirely convincing as David Raya tries to punch but fails to get the ball away.
 It bobbles back towards goal and Gabriel has to hack it away off the line.
 124 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HITS THE WOODWORK published at 15:18 BST 15:18 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 So close for Fulham!
 Josh King is given far too much space inside the box and he shoots, smashing the ball against the woodwork. The rebound falls to Alex Iwobi but he flashes his effort wide.
 A let off for Coventry.
 86 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:17 BST 15:17 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Nice football from Everton and it ends with the ball being worked left to Tyrique
George.
 The winger cuts inside and flashes a shot just wide of the far post.
 It took a deflection, though, and the visitors have a corner.
 123 98 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:17 BST 15:17 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 Coventry City had three shots in the opening three minutes, the earliest they have reached three shots in a Premier League game this season.
 Since then, however, they have struggled to create much in the final third.
 28 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Everton 'reacted well so far' published at 15:16 BST 15:16 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Pat Nevin 
Former Everton winger on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Looking at Everton on the ball just now, there's a real comfort on the ball. I didn't see that last week at the Hill Dickinson against Chelsea. 
 They've reacted well so far. 
 133 112 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:16 BST 15:16 BST 
 Coventry 0-0 Fulham 
 It hasn't been the most exciting of encounters so far but Fulham fans will be happy, their side are largely controlling matters without massively threatening.
 69 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:16 BST 15:16 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Alex Howell 
BBC Sport Arsenal reporter at Emirates Stadium 
 David Moyes is unhappy with something. 
 He is animatedly shouting towards the referee for a foul that he feels Everton should have had. 
 54 102 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 15:15 BST 15:15 BST 
 Arsenal 1-0 Everton 
 Remarkably, given their reputation, that was Arsenal's first goal from a set piece in the Premier League this season.
 242 59 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 15:14 BST 15:14 BST 
 Arsenal 0-0 Everton 
 And now the complaints about Arsenal's style can return to Set Piece FC.
 Matt, Germany 
 The set piece goals are back. Phew.
 James, London 
 Set piece again! Set piece again! Ole, ole. Welcome back Arsenal it's been a while.
 Oliver, London
